annotations.title: Tell me when a company has a referrer

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. For a company with no referrer yet (list_company_referrers returned nobody): techjobs.vn tells the signed-in user once, in the app, when a verified referrer joins that company. Pass watch=false to stop. Up to 20 companies at a time. Repeating a call changes nothing.

slug.description: Company slug from search_companies or search_jobs, e.g. "mckinsey".

watch.description: true (default) = tell the user when the company has a referrer; false = stop.

name: watch_company_referrers
title: Tell me when a company has a referrer
